narrativeProgression.description: Hannity asks Manchin about his recent tour and the possibility of forming a 'No Labels' party.
Hannity asks if Manchin received enough feedback to consider a presidential run under a third party.
Manchin asserts that he would consider any option that would allow him to help his country.
He emphasizes the need to bring political extremes back to the middle ground.
Manchin describes the 'No Labels' movement as a balanced venue for Democrats and Republicans who feel unrepresented by their parties.
